newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares track U.S. up, seen recouping losses.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares track U.S. up, seen recouping losses.

text.p: Danish share prices on Wednesday aped last night's Wall Street rally and dealers expected local stocks to recoup Tuesday's losses and perhaps make a little extra.
"The U.S. came back strongly yesterday and that will make the Danish market rise half a percent or a little more," a dealer said. The KFX share index fell 0.48 percent on Tuesday.
At 0740 GMT the KFX was up 0.28 point -- 0.16 percent -- from Tuesday's close, to 172.56.
Close attention was expected to be paid to Danisco which publishes full year results later in the day.

After falling four crowns on Tuesday, despite expectations of a 12.7 percent rise in pre-tax profits, the Danisco share was on the rise Wednesday morning, up one crown to 430.00 at 0745 GMT. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom + 45 33969650
